verifications.claim: Robert Mueller died on Friday night, March 20, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "died on Friday night in Charlottesville, Va." (R1); "passed away on Friday night" (R2); "died on Friday" (R3, R4); published dates March 21/22, 2026 confirm Friday as March 20
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm death on Friday (night), and publication dates directly support March 20, 2026 as the Friday prior.

verifications.reasoning: Every reference explicitly states he died at age 81.

verifications.claim: Robert Mueller died in Charlottesville, Virginia.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "died on Friday night in Charlottesville, Va." (R1); "died Friday in Charlottesville, Virginia" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: R1 and R4 directly state the location of death.

verifications.claim: Robert Mueller's family did not specify an immediate cause of his death.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "did not say where he died or specify the cause" (R1); "The cause of his death was not immediately clear" (R2); "No cause of death was given" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources confirm family did not specify cause.

verifications.claim: Robert Mueller was diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease in 2021.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mr. Mueller was diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease in the summer of 2021" (R1)

verifications.claim: Robert Mueller had been battling Parkinson’s disease since the summer of 2021.
verifications.label: VAGUE

verifications.reasoning: Diagnosis in summer 2021 implies battling since then, but sources use 'diagnosed' rather than 'battling since'.
